intl-foot-definition.org: International yard and pound agreement (1959) — definition
intl-foot-definition.basis: 1 foot = 0.3048 m exactly, so 1 sq ft = 0.09290304 m². 1 acre = 43,560 sq ft. 1 hectare = 10,000 m². 1 sq yd (gaj) = 9 sq ft. These are definitions, not survey data.

bajaj-marla-kanal.org: Bajaj Finserv — Marla to Kanal guide (secondary source)
bajaj-marla-kanal.basis: 1 kanal = 20 marla; marla standardised at 272.25 sq ft (30.25 sq yd). Some regions use other marla sizes.

bajaj-guntha-acre.org: Bajaj Finserv — Guntha to Acre guide (secondary source)

1acre-cent.org: 1acre.in — Cent to sq ft converter (secondary source)
1acre-cent.basis: 1 cent = 1/100 acre = 435.6 sq ft; 'decimal' is the same area.

dilrmp.org: Department of Land Resources, Govt of India — DILRMP
dilrmp.basis: National land-records modernisation programme; publishes the State/UT RoR portal directory and modernisation status. Treated as the national discovery layer, not proof that every state offers identical services.

bajaj-bhulekh-portals.org: Bajaj Finserv — Bhulekh portals by state (secondary source)
bajaj-bhulekh-portals.basis: Lists commonly used state Bhulekh portals; used only to corroborate portal names/domains. Confirm the live address on the state portal.

portal-up.org: UP Bhulekh — Revenue Department, Uttar Pradesh
portal-up.basis: State portal for khatauni/khasra-gata records. Domain corroborated by several guides; live check pending.

portal-mh-thane.basis: District government page describing Mahabhulekh (bhulekh.mahabhumi.gov.in) as the portal for 7/12 utara, 8A and property card, and listing the digital-signature service.

portal-rj.org: Apna Khata — Board of Revenue, Rajasthan
portal-rj.basis: Rajasthan jamabandi/khata portal. Some sources give apnakhata.raj.nic.in; confirm the current domain.

portal-mp.org: MP Bhulekh — Government of Madhya Pradesh
portal-mp.basis: Madhya Pradesh khasra/khatauni/Bhu-Naksha portal. Domain corroborated by guides; live check pending.

portal-br.org: Bihar Bhumi — Department of Revenue and Land Reforms, Bihar
portal-br.basis: Bihar land-records portal (jamabandi, dakhil-kharij services). Domain corroborated by guides; live check pending.

portal-gj.basis: Gujarat Record of Rights (7/12, 8-A) portal. Domain corroborated by guides; live check pending.

portal-hr-news.org: Drishti IAS — e-Fard system implemented in Haryana (secondary source)
portal-hr-news.basis: Reports Haryana's digitally signed Jamabandi (e-Fard) via jamabandi.nic.in from 6 May 2023. Fees are not reproduced here; check the portal.

portal-hr.basis: Haryana jamabandi / fard portal as named in news coverage; live check pending.

portal-pb.basis: Punjab jamabandi/fard portal. Some guides route via plrs.org.in; confirm the current domain.

portal-dl-doc.org: Revenue Department, Delhi — notice listing Indraprastha Bhu-Lekh
portal-dl-doc.basis: Official Delhi revenue document linking the ROR service to Indraprastha Bhu-Lekh at dlrc.delhigovt.nic.in; other sources give dlrc.delhi.gov.in.

portal-dl.basis: Delhi Khasra-Khatauni (DLR Act) service. Two domains appear in sources; check both before use.

portal-uk-guide.org: Tata Capital — Devbhoomi Uttarakhand land records guide (secondary source)
portal-uk-guide.basis: Describes Bhulekh Uttarakhand public ROR lookup. The official domain could not be confirmed from the sources found; verify on the Uttarakhand revenue department site.

portal-hp-district.basis: District government page noting public nakals of jamabandi and shajra nasb via the HimBhoomi software against nominal charges.

portal-hp.basis: Himachal jamabandi portal. Sources also list himbhoomilmk.nic.in; confirm the live domain.

portal-jk-news.org: Daily Excelsior — J&K revenue services report (secondary source)
portal-jk-news.basis: Reports that Jamabandi, Massavi, Mutation and Girdawari records can be accessed without registration on the online portal.

portal-jk.basis: Jammu & Kashmir Revenue Department land records portal; live check pending.

editorial-general.org: LandRecord editorial — general educational overview (no jurisdiction-specific legal source cited)
editorial-general.basis: General explanatory guidance in plain language. It cites no section numbers, fees, time limits or outcomes. State rules differ; confirm with the revenue office or a qualified lawyer.

techobserver-dilrmp3.org: Tech Observer — DILRMP 3.0 and Bhu-Aadhaar report (secondary source)
techobserver-dilrmp3.basis: Reports DILRMP 3.0 (2026–2031) with Bhu-Aadhaar. Figures and dates must be re-verified on dolr.gov.in / dilrmp.gov.in.

homenesto-bhuaadhaar.org: HomeNesto — DILRMP 3.0 and Bhu-Aadhaar explainer (secondary source)
homenesto-bhuaadhaar.basis: Describes Bhu-Aadhaar as a 14-digit land-parcel ID. Treat as a pointer; confirm details with the Department of Land Resources.

housing-cts.org: Housing.com — CTS number in Mumbai (secondary source)
housing-cts.basis: Explains the CTS (city survey) number and that it appears on the property card (malmatta patrak). Check Mahabhulekh / the local CTS office for current procedure.

portal-ka.org: Bhoomi — Karnataka Revenue Department land records
portal-ka.basis: Karnataka RTC/mutation-report portal; address corroborated by guides; live check pending.

ka-guide.basis: Describes RTC (Record of Rights, Tenancy and Crops), mutation extract and the 'View RTC and MR' route. Fees are not reproduced here.

tg-news-dc.org: Deccan Chronicle — Bhu Bharati portal goes live, replaces Dharani (news)
tg-news-dc.basis: Reports Bhu Bharati launched 14 April 2025 replacing Dharani. The official domain was not confirmed from the sources found.

tg-news-theweek.org: The Week (PTI) — Telangana CM launches Bhu Bharati portal
tg-news-theweek.basis: Wire report on the Bhu Bharati launch and the new land-records law.

portal-ap.basis: Andhra Pradesh Adangal / 1-B portal; address corroborated by guides; live check pending.

ap-guide.org: ClearTax — Mee Bhoomi AP guide (secondary source)
ap-guide.basis: Describes Adangal and 1-B lookups on Meebhoomi. Confirm menus on the portal.

tn-india-gov.org: India.gov.in — e-Services of land records (Tamil Nadu)
tn-india-gov.basis: National services directory entry stating that Tamil Nadu e-Services lets citizens view and verify Pattas and A-Register extracts.

portal-tn.basis: Tamil Nadu Patta/Chitta, A-Register, FMB and TSLR extract service.

portal-wb.org: Banglarbhumi — Land & Land Reforms Department, West Bengal
portal-wb.basis: West Bengal khatian/plot information portal; address corroborated by guides; live check pending.

wb-guide.basis: Describes khatian and plot search by district, block and mouza.

portal-od.basis: Odisha RoR (Khatiyan) portal. Most guides use bhulekh.ori.nic.in; one lists bhulekh.odisha.gov.in; confirm which is live.

od-guide.org: Bajaj Finserv — Bhulekh Odisha guide (secondary source)
od-guide.basis: Describes RoR search by district, tahasil, RI circle and village, and BhuNaksha for maps. Fees are not reproduced here.

portal-cg.basis: Chhattisgarh B-1/P-II (khasra nakal) portal; address corroborated by guides; live check pending.

cg-guide.org: 1acre — Chhattisgarh khasra / B-1 nakal document guide (secondary source)
cg-guide.basis: Describes B-1 and the route via district, tehsil, RI and village. Sources disagree on whether a digitally signed copy is accepted for loans/registration.

portal-jh.basis: Jharkhand khatiyan/jamabandi portal. Another listed address is jharbhoomi.jharkhand.gov.in; confirm which is live.

jh-district.org: Ramgarh District (NIC) — land records service page
jh-district.basis: District government page that links the Jharbhoomi service.
